recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數顆早期紅血球前驅細胞（前紅血球母細胞／嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞），細胞質深藍、邊緣集中許多圓形清晰空泡，部分顆粒球前驅細胞也見空泡，符合銅缺乏引起的造血前驅細胞空泡化。
features: Cluster of early erythroid precursors (pronormoblasts/basophilic normoblasts) with round nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Multiple discrete, round, clear cytoplasmic vacuoles in the erythroid precursors, concentrated at the cell periphery
Scattered granulocytic precursors (promyelocyte, myelocytes, bands) with some showing occasional vacuoles
Erythroid and myeloid maturation present; no increase in blasts evident in this field
Background red cells and fine stain precipitate/debris
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows granulocytic and erythroid precursors with maturation. Several early erythroid precursors with deeply basophilic cytoplasm contain multiple round, sharply demarcated clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, and occasional granulocytic precursors are also vacuolated. There is no obvious increase in blasts or overt megaloblastic change in this field. In a child on long-term parenteral nutrition with pancytopenia, findings are consistent with copper deficiency; similar vacuolization may be seen with zinc toxicity, alcohol, chloramphenicol, Pearson syndrome or myelodysplastic neoplasm, so serum copper and ceruloplasmin should be checked and iron stain assessed for ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: MDS shows multilineage dysplasia (hypolobated megakaryocytes, pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, nuclear budding) with possible increased blasts and clonal cytogenetics, whereas copper deficiency vacuoles reverse with copper replacement.
Pearson syndrome shows identical vacuoles with ring sideroblasts in infancy together with exocrine pancreatic insufficiency and mitochondrial DNA deletion.
These produce the same pronormoblast vacuoles and are distinguished by exposure history.
Burkitt cells are uniform lymphoid blasts with sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles and absent maturation rather than vacuolated erythroid precursors within a maturing marrow.
